Keep the details visible
  • Remove the sleeve and place one card on a plain, dark background.
  • Photograph it straight from above, upright, with all four corners visible.
  • Use soft, even light. Avoid flash, glare and shadows.
  • Keep the card sharp and at least 900 pixels tall. Include both front and back for a trained grade estimate.

About GemLens

Upload clear front and back photos. GemLens finds a rectangular card boundary, looks for consistent inner-border transitions, and highlights bright, low-color patches near the edges and corners.

What the numbers mean

Centering compares opposing border widths. Edge and corner scores use the area of possible whitening. The overall estimate uses a PyTorch model trained on 10,000 paired card scans. The criterion scores and issue markers are separate rule-based checks, not learned subgrades or explanations of the model’s estimate. They have not been calibrated against professional grades.

What needs a human eye

Artwork, silver borders, glare and sleeves can look like damage. Full-art borders can make centering unmeasurable. The tool cannot reliably detect dents, texture wear, authenticity, or fine scratches. Surface condition is flagged for manual review and is not scored.

Reading issue labels

Orange circles locate suspected whitening. Select a label below the image to isolate it. Light patches span less than 2.5% of the card width or height, moderate patches span 2.5–8%, and pronounced patches span at least 8%. These describe detected extent, not confirmed damage or a calibrated severity rating.

Built with Python

The Python server runs the trained PyTorch model on front and back photos, including corner and edge details. Photos are processed in memory and are not saved. Browser-only mode provides clearly labeled rule-based inspection without the trained model. Model results are experimental: validation used card scans, and performance on everyday phone photos has not been independently established.

Best results: an upright card, a plain dark background, no sleeve, all corners visible, and at least 900 pixels along the card’s height. Adjust the detected boundary when needed.
